mapper.select:
select lc.id, lc.code, lc.name, lc.disabled, ls.id as logisticsSupplierId, ls.supplier_name as supplierName from logistics_channel lc inner join logistics_supplier ls on lc.main_id = ls.id and ls.is_deleted = false where lc.is_deleted = false
and lc.main_id in
#{item}
and lc.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.name}::text,'%')
order by lc.disabled asc,lc.id desc

SELECT lc.id, lc.name, lc.code, lc.disabled FROM logistics_channel lc INNER JOIN logistics_supplier ls ON lc.main_id = ls.id and ls.is_deleted = false WHERE lc.is_deleted=false AND ls.supplier_id=#{supplierId}

SELECT lc.id, lc.name, lc.code, lc.disabled FROM logistics_channel_address lca INNER JOIN logistics_channel lc ON lca.logistics_channel_id = lc.id and lc.is_deleted = false WHERE lca.is_deleted=false AND lca.address_id=#{addressId}

select lc.id, lc.main_id, lc.name, lc.code from logistics_channel lc LEFT JOIN logistics_sale_channel lsc on lc.source_id = lsc.id where lc.is_deleted = false and lc.name = #{channelName} or lsc.cn_name = #{channelName}

select id,name as value,code,disabled,logisticsSupplierId,logisticsSupplierName from ( select lc.id, lc.name, lc.code, lc.disabled, ls.id as logisticsSupplierId, ls.short_name as logisticsSupplierName from logistics_channel lc left join logistics_supplier ls on ls.id = lc.main_id and ls.is_deleted = false where lc.is_deleted = false and ls.id is not null
and ((lc.code = #{params.searchKeyword}) or (lc.id = #{params.searchKeyword}) or lc.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
and lc.disabled=#{params.disabled}
order by lc.disabled asc,
case when lc.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when lc.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when lc.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , lc.name,
code asc ) wls
